context:
Goal: keep the design skill on its newest version.
Problem (risk): impeccable 4.8.0's critique.md and audit.md tell agents to start Electron or WebView2 apps with --remote-debugging-port. The port is bound to 127.0.0.1, so only programs on this machine can reach it; while it is open, any of them can drive the app. No ruling or guard covers it.
Based on (read): the lane's changelog read of impeccable 4.8.0 (lane renovate-917-918).
Departs from: main has impeccable 4.6.0, which never launches an app with a debug port (no remote-debugging-port on origin/main) — 4.8.0's reference/critique.md step 1 and reference/audit.md 'Desktop apps' add that launch, bound to 127.0.0.1.

Not blocking. The default that keeps main's behaviour is built: impeccable 4.8.0 and guard rule debug-port-ask, which asks before such a launch (option a), landed in batch 50, #946 (Nov 1 10:28 CST). Your pick still governs: b removes the guard rule; c returns the skill to 4.6.0.

lastAnswer.note: how do we ensure the port wont clash?

options.gain: The newest skill, with each debug-port launch approved by you.
options.how: Take 4.8.0. A guard rule asks you before any command that starts an app with --remote-debugging-port.
options.label: Take 4.8.0, plus a guard that asks before a debug-port launch
options.lose: One more prompt each time a design review opens a debug port.

options.how: Merge lane/impeccable-4.8.0 with no new guard.
options.label: Take 4.8.0 as is
options.lose: Debug ports open with no check.

options.how: Close the bump, and skip impeccable bumps until this is decided again.
options.label: Stay on 4.6.0

reply: Built pick b: guard rule debug-port-ask removed. On the clash: 9222 in the skill is only an example; detect --cdp takes any port. Launch with --remote-debugging-port=0 and the OS picks a free port, written to DevToolsActivePort; pass it to detect --cdp. Measured on headless Chrome (got 43677). Electron and WebView2 not measured.
title: Impeccable 4.8.0 tells agents to open a debug port on apps. Take it?
why: It keeps main's behaviour (no unasked debug port) and still takes the newest skill.
